channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Tornado in France injures 41 and damages hundreds of homes
item.description: Wind speeds were estimated at up to 73 mph.

item.title: FBI announces $25,000 minimum reward for unsolved cases in Indian Country
item.description: The FBI now offers at least $25,000 for information leading to resolution of certain cold cases involving missing persons or homicides in Indian Country.

item.title: Trump and Kennedy's health industry deals may collapse
item.description: The agreements, which address drug pricing, synthetic food dye reduction, and insurance prior authorization limits, are at risk.

item.title: 'Bully': Trump and Ontario's Doug Ford clash over trade war
item.description: Ford suggested Canada should use all available measures against Trump.
